trip_one_star_average.referencePeriod: Trip.com weekday average; weekend (Friday-Saturday) average separately shown as EUR41; result crawled last week (July 2026)
trip_one_star_average.evidenceText: For 1 star hotels in Bangkok, the average cost on weekdays is €39, and the usual price on weekends (Friday–Saturday) is €41.
trip_one_star_average.searchQuery: site:trip.com Bangkok Thailand 1-star hotel average nightly price
trip_one_star_average.reason: The Trip.com result identifies Bangkok and the 1-star class and reports numeric weekday and weekend nightly averages. No two-adult/one-room occupancy is stated, so the occupancy basis remains unknown; the weekend value was retained in evidence and not averaged.

hotelscombined_one_star_average.searchQuery: site:hotelscombined.com Bangkok Thailand 1-star hotel average nightly price
hotelscombined_one_star_average.reason: HotelsCombined results reported overall Bangkok averages, 3- to 5-star trends, and property-level comparisons, but no exact-city 1-star statistic. Overall, other-class, and property values were rejected.

budgetyourtrip_one_star_average.referencePeriod: Budget Your Trip current hotel-price analysis; 139 1-star hotels; prices before taxes and fees; result crawled 2 weeks ago (July 2026)
budgetyourtrip_one_star_average.sourceTitle: How Much Do Hotels Cost in Bangkok? Hotel Prices for Bangkok, Thailand | Budget Your Trip
budgetyourtrip_one_star_average.evidenceText: $28 is the average price of the 139 1-star hotels in Bangkok. The median price for these great hotels is $22.
budgetyourtrip_one_star_average.searchQuery: site:budgetyourtrip.com Bangkok Thailand 1-star hotel average nightly price
budgetyourtrip_one_star_average.reason: The Budget Your Trip result identifies Bangkok and 1-star hotels and reports a numeric average nightly price in USD. It does not state two adults and one room, so occupancy remains unknown; the separately reported median was not substituted or averaged.
